label: late copy phase of long sequences, gated by current input token
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), essentially only from the 4th copied output on (recall_idx >= 3; ~98% of activations), and mostly in long sequences (L >= 7 carries ~93% of mass). Rate rises with position: about 25% of steps at t = 12-15 and 38% at t = 17. Within that window the token being input strongly modulates firing: 0, r, b, d, p, c, o, 3, f, h are favored (lift 2-3x), and the output token (j, i, 0) and previous token (i) add weaker effects. It never fires on a token at its first occurrence in the sequence (in_first = 0 for every activation), which is automatic in the copy phase. Position alone gives high recall but low precision (F1 ~0.37). Adding the token set raises F1 to ~0.54 with mass recall ~0.77, and top-quartile activations are better covered. The remaining dependence looks like a distributed token-identity mix that this predicate does not capture.
